scope: nested planning subtracks, not new top-level registry entries

tracks.title: Inventory, eligibility and existing-asset reuse
tracks.evidence: partial metadata/code inspection; not a complete asset census
tracks.acceptance: source/period/boundary/query-specific inventory with pinned revisions and original-byte verification

tracks.title: Source-native socioeconomic normalisation
tracks.evidence: external synthetic CSV reference prototype; no real source profile admitted
tracks.acceptance: qualified original CSV/API metadata, explicit dimensions and statuses, independently reconciled observations

tracks.title: Geography, boundary and statistical populations
tracks.evidence: exact geography guards in external prototype; no real concordance qualification
tracks.acceptance: direct source-vintage joins first; independently validated count/distribution concordances where needed

tracks.title: Temporal electoral joins and analytical panels
external_dependencies: accepted P2/P6 party, geography and result-vintage contracts
tracks.evidence: external as-of/exact-join prototype on synthetic rows
tracks.acceptance: cardinality, missingness, temporal provenance and independent source-total parity

tracks.title: Socioeconomic outcomes and research qualification
tracks.evidence: external synthetic unweighted ecological association and independent numerical oracle
tracks.acceptance: validated real descriptive outcomes with coverage; separately qualified statistical models

tracks.title: Research publication, source-state UI and freshness
external_dependencies: existing P9 publication owner and explicit release authority
tracks.acceptance: source-to-Gold-to-export-to-served-HF parity, accessible UI and immutable release/rollback evidence
